title: 第61章 没话说，就给我闭嘴！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 听到这话二处一群人顿时怒火中烧。瞧不起谁呢？妈的，没有你们二处，我们还不破案了是吗？只是怒归怒，迫于苏狂的威压，始终没有人敢骂出来。宁川也是怒了，虽然他很清楚这其中有唐逸的挑拨离间，可相比于唐逸的挑拨离间，他更不爽的是苏狂的不识好歹。敲打我？你大爷的，给你脸了是吧？老子知道吴勇身份的第一时间，往上报的同时让人将事情告诉你了。你特妈当时醉死在女人的肚皮上了，你现在怪我？“不需要，案子我们自己破，就不劳你们二处操心了。”宁川抬手指着大门，下逐客令：“苏狂，现在，你可以带着你的人滚了。”妈的，真以为老子找你们帮忙，是觉得你们的能力比一处强？老子单纯是觉得人多力量大，或许你们能注意到我们一处没注意的细节。至于你们破案率高，呵呵，别人不知道怎么回事，老子还不知道吗？为了破案你们不择手段滥用私刑，不讲规矩不遵法律，一个案子查出真相了，却又造成了多少冤案？老子都羞于你们为伍！苏狂目光骤冷，嘴角却带着笑容。“宁川，看来你对这个新人很有信心啊！”苏狂没有理会宁川，目光盯着唐逸：“那就别废话了，敢不敢玩一把大的？”“我们二处输了，脱光绕着京都跑一圈。”“你们输了，同样脱光绕着京都跑一圈。”“同时，我要他的脑袋当夜壶。”苏狂舌尖舔了舔手中的刀刃，狂妄至极。一切，都是因为这废物才失控的！他必须死。“哈哈，苏头威武，苏头霸气！”“一处的，你们刚才不是很狂吗？拿出你们刚才的气势来！”“……”二处的人也都狞笑起来，冲着一处众人叫嚣。看到这一幕，一处一群人攥紧拳头，脸色铁青。心头只觉得屈辱无比！真答应下来，以二处不择手段的作风，他们的确没有任何胜算。宁川心头也是窝火得不行，论武功他比苏狂高出好几个档次，但论无耻，他远不是苏狂的对手。“赌就赌，怕他们干嘛？”萧棣的暴脾气当场就爆炸了。他肩膀撞了一下唐逸，道：“你怎么说？别说你也怕了。”“不是怕？是筹码不等。”唐逸睨了一眼苏狂，道：“他们输了，只是裸奔，我们输了，不仅要裸奔，还得奉上我的项上人头。”“我的头，很贵的。”唐逸看向宁川：“宁头，咱们一处有多少人？”“算上外勤，三十人。”宁川眉头微皱，这家伙想要干什么？唐逸点点头，看向苏狂道：“这样吧，我们输了，脱光衣服城外跑一圈外，我的脑袋只要你能拿走，随便你处置。”“但是，你们若是输了，嗯……脑袋给我当夜壶就不用了，膈应！不过，你们除了脱光跑一圈外，得给我们一处所有同僚每人一千两。”“你们，敢赌吗？”闻言，宁川瞳孔骤缩，一处一群人也都瞪大双眼。我草，小子你来真的啊！太年轻了，你根本不知道他们这群人有多无耻。就算后面查不到真凶，他们也能合理安排出一个真凶出来。这就是二处无案不破的手段！“等等。”宁川连忙站出来，想要阻止。苏狂冷笑一声，直接抢先开口道：“好，有意思，赌了。”苏狂挥了挥手，二处立即有人将契约拿了出来。他将契约丢到宁川面前，道：“宁千户，签字吧，把字签了，赌约就成了。”“然后，你们就可以安心等着脱裤子，到城外裸奔了，哈哈……”宁川看着手中的文书，气到爆炸。妈的，连契约都准备好了，果然是早有预谋。而唐逸和萧棣这两个蠢蛋，竟然一脚踩进人家的坑里面去了。一个皇子，全身光着在城外裸奔，皇家的颜面何在？你们还真特妈敢玩！但现在都到这一步了，他还能怎么办？只能冷着脸将契约书给签了，至于唐逸和萧棣，等下再收拾他们。“签了，滚吧！”宁川签了协议，将契约丢回给苏狂。苏狂接了契约，大笑一声带着二处的人离开。“等下，宁头，我补充几句。”唐逸睨了苏狂一眼，嘴角微挑。只是笑容充满冷意。“苏千户，说我抢你们的功劳？谁给你们的脸的？”唐逸走到苏狂的面前，目光和苏狂冰冷对峙：“如果不是我推测出吴勇的身份，现在吴勇已经被你们放走了。”“然后，你们拿着吴勇的巨额保释金潇洒。”“吴勇呢？则是在我大炎京都潇洒，不断将我大炎的情报输送回北狄，让北狄和东虞更好地瓜分我大炎北境。”“到时候，数十万甚至上百万的人会死！”“如果发生这种情况，我敢问苏千户……这是不是你们的功劳？！”唐逸眼神冰冷，声音陡然拔高：“说话！”全场死寂！二处众人都面色铁青，眼底寒意逼人。这话很诛心，就差指着二处骂他们通敌叛国了。一处一群人却是满脸错愕，这家伙这么狂的吗？竟然将他们不敢说的话，直接怼在了苏狂的脸上？苏狂眉心直跳，差点忍不住拔刀砍人。“没话说了？那就好好闭嘴，别学野狗狂吠！”唐逸面带微笑，抬手帮苏狂捋平有些凌乱的飞鱼服：“做人，要懂得感恩，我们一处帮你们破了案，避免了重大损失，是你们的恩人。”“对待恩人，记得要客气点！”“好了，说完了，现在你们可以滚了！”唐逸潇洒退到一边。几句话，怼得二处众人脸色青红交替，苏狂脸色更是森冷至极。还以为彻底将一处踩在脚下了，没想到离开竟然反被唐逸踩回去，该死啊！“好，活好，此处该有掌声！哈哈哈……”萧棣也觉得解气，当场给唐逸鼓起了掌。“好，说得好，就不能惯着他们。”“听到没？老子特妈是你们恩人，对恩人客气点。”“……”一处一群人也都鼓起了掌，心头郁结顿时一扫而光。就连宁川，嘴角也有了笑容。苏狂手下意识攥成拳，盯着眼前的少年，杀意凛然。敢在他面前嘚瑟的人有很多，但是，都死光了。“笑吧，尽情地笑吧！”“这，是你们这辈子……最后的笑容了。”苏狂冷哼一声，带着二处的人离开了房间。现在一处的人被唐逸弄得同仇敌忾，真要动手，他们占不了一点便宜。
content_en: When they heard this, a group of people in the second place became furious.Who do you look down on?Damn it, without you two offices, we still wouldn’t have solved the case, right?It's just that they were angry. Due to Su Kuang's pressure, no one dared to curse.Ning Chuan was also angry. Although he knew very well that Tang Yi was sowing discord, but compared to Tang Yi's sowing discord, he was more unhappy with Su Kuang's ignorance of good and evil.Knock me out?It's your uncle's fault, I'm giving you face, right?As soon as I knew Wu Yong's identity, I reported it to you and asked someone to tell you the matter.Your mother was so drunk that she died on a woman's belly. Now you blame me?"No need, we will solve the case ourselves, so we don't have to worry about you two." Ning Chuan raised his finger to the door and issued an eviction order: "Su Kuang, now you can take your people and get out." Damn it, do you really think I asked you for help because I think you are better than the other department?I simply believe that there is strength in numbers. Maybe you can notice some details that we didn’t pay attention to.As for your high crime detection rate, haha, if others don’t know what’s going on, don’t I know?In order to solve the case, you abused lynching by any means, did not follow the rules and did not abide by the law. The truth was found in one case, but how many unjust cases were caused?I'm ashamed to be in your company!Su Kuang's eyes suddenly turned cold, but there was a smile on his lips."Ning Chuan, it seems that you are very confident in this newcomer!" Su Kuang ignored Ning Chuan and stared at Tang Yi: "Then stop talking nonsense, do you dare to play a big one?" "We lost in the second place, strip naked and run around Kyoto." "If you lose, you will also strip naked and run around Kyoto." "At the same time, I want his head to be a chamber pot." Su Kuang licked the blade in his hand with the tip of his tongue, extremely arrogant.Everything got out of control because of this waste!He must die."Haha, Su Tou is mighty, Su Tou is domineering!" "First Department, weren't you crazy just now? Show your momentum!" "..." People from the Second Department also laughed ferociously and shouted at everyone in the First Department.Seeing this scene, a group of people in one place clenched their fists and turned pale.I just feel extremely humiliated!If they really agree to it, with their unscrupulous style, they really have no chance of winning.Ning Chuan was also very angry. In terms of martial arts, he was several levels higher than Su Kuang, but in terms of shamelessness, he was far from Su Kuang's opponent."Just bet, why are you afraid of them?" Xiao Di's temper exploded on the spot.He bumped Tang Yi with his shoulder and said: "What did you say? Don't say you are scared too." "Not scared? It's because the chips are not equal." Tang Yi glanced at Su Kuang and said: "They lost, they just ran naked, we lost, we not only ran naked"My head is very expensive."Tang Yi looked at Ning Chuan: "Ning Tou, how many people are there in our office?"Ning Chuan frowned, what does this guy want to do?Tang Yi nodded, looked at Su Kuang and said: "Let's see, if we lose, we'll take off our clothes and run around the city. You can take my head and do whatever you want with it." "But if you lose, well... give me your head for the night."No need for the pot, Ge Ying!However, in addition to stripping off and running around, you have to give each of our colleagues a thousand taels." Hearing this, Ning Chuan's pupils shrank suddenly, and everyone in the group also widened their eyes.Damn it, boy, are you serious!You are too young and you have no idea how shameless these people are.Even if the real culprit cannot be found later, they can still make reasonable arrangements to find a real culprit.This is the method used by the two departments to solve no case!"Wait." Ning Chuan quickly stood up and wanted to stop him.Su Kuang sneered and spoke first: "Okay, it's interesting, let's take a bet." Su Kuang waved his hand, and someone from the second office immediately took out the contract.He threw the contract in front of Ning Chuan and said, "Ning Qianhu, sign it. Once you sign it, the bet will be settled." "Then you can wait and take off your pants and run naked outside the city, haha..." Ning Chuan looked at the document in his hand and was so angry that he exploded.Damn it, even the contract was prepared, it was indeed premeditated.But these two idiots, Tang Yi and Xiao Di, actually stepped into their trap.A prince is running naked outside the city. Where is the dignity of the royal family?You guys are really brave enough to play!But now that it's come to this, what else can he do?He could only sign the contract with a cold face. As for Tang Yi and Xiao Di, he would deal with them later."Signed, get out!" Ning Chuan signed the agreement and threw the contract back to Su Kuang.Su Kuang accepted the contract, laughed loudly and left with the people from the second office."Wait a minute, Ning Tou, let me add a few words." Tang Yi glanced at Su Kuang and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.It's just that the smile is full of coldness."Su Qianhu, you said that I took your credit? Who gave you the face?" Tang Yi walked up to Su Kuang and looked at Su Kuang coldly: "If I hadn't guessed Wu Yong's identity, Wu Yong would have been let go by you now." "Then, you took Wu Yong's huge bail money to be cool." "Where is Wu Yong? He was so cool in my great Yan Kyoto., and continue to send information about my Dayan back to Beidi, so that Beidi and Dongyu can better divide my territory in the north."If this happens, I dare to ask Su Qianhu... is this due to you?"Tang Yi's eyes were cold, and his voice suddenly rose: "Speak!"Everyone in the two places looked livid, and their eyes were filled with coldness.These words were very heartbreaking, almost pointing at the two departments and scolding them for collaborating with the enemy and treason.A group of people in one place looked astonished. Is this guy so crazy?They actually said what they didn't dare to say directly in Su Kuang's face?Su Kuang's eyebrows pounded and he almost couldn't help but draw a knife to kill someone."You have nothing to say? Then shut up and don't bark like a wild dog!" Tang Yi smiled and raised his hand to help Su Kuang smooth the messy Feiyu suit: "As a human being, you must know how to be grateful. We helped you solve the case and avoided heavy losses. We are your benefactors." "Remember to be polite when treating your benefactor!" "Okay, that's it, you can get out now!" Tang Yi stepped aside gracefully.A few words made everyone in the two places turn blue and red in shock, and Su Kuang's face turned extremely cold.I thought I had completely stepped on something, but I didn't expect that when I left, Tang Yi stepped back on me. Damn it!"Okay, good life, there should be applause here! Hahaha..." Xiao Di also felt relieved and applauded Tang Yi on the spot."Okay, that's right, you can't spoil them." "Did you hear that? I am your special mother.
title_en: Chapter 61 If you have nothing to say, just shut up!
